scenarios.scenario: PUBLIC grant regression: create or replace leaves the function executable by public/anon/authenticated.
scenarios.rationale: Migration restates revoke from public,anon,authenticated and grant to service_role; runner check 5e asserts service_role true, anon false, authenticated false after all migrations.

scenarios.scenario: search_path hijack: redefinition drops SET search_path so unqualified names resolve to attacker objects.
scenarios.rationale: Function copied verbatim with security definer set search_path = ''; checkout-access-guard.sql asserts prosecdef and proconfig contains search_path="".

scenarios.scenario: Late payment bypass: longer window lets a payment after link expiry be marked paid.
scenarios.rationale: process_payos_webhook unchanged; check 5d forces link expiry into the past and asserts reconciliation with failure_code late_or_terminal_payment.

scenarios.scenario: Strike-window evasion via longer link: 10-minute links push strike evidence outside the 1-hour lookback.
scenarios.rationale: Strike logic reads stored least(link, order) expiry with a 1-hour lower bound; a 10-minute link moves a strike 5 minutes later, well inside the window. Existing runner strike cases pass unchanged.
